Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Vocational Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Vocational Instructor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the Vocational Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronic & Communication Engineering with a minimum of one year of experience in the trade.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 65 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Vocational Instructor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Hubballi, Karnataka, 580020.
